name: secret_hitler
title: Secret Hitler
description: A hidden-role social deduction game of policy enactment, deception, and deduction for 5-10 players.

episodeSteps.description: Maximum number of steps in the episode.

actTimeout.description: Seconds an agent has to act each turn.

runTimeout.description: Maximum runtime of the episode in seconds.

seed.description: Random seed for deterministic role/id/deck shuffling.

randomize_roles.description: Whether to shuffle the configured roles among players.

randomize_ids.description: Whether to shuffle the configured player ids.

agents.description: Per-player configuration. Provide exactly one entry per player; role counts must match the player count.

reward.description: +1 for winners, -1 for losers, 0 for a no-winner timeout.
